item.title: Delusions
item.description:
Today, when I was in market, in a showroom of cloths
I saw a mannequin in a bride's dress, her hands were out in smooth pattern she was sitting on the bench
i was too close to it, thinking about her, I saw in her eyes grabbing her fingers softly closing eyes,I felt her, then I am in absolute depression
the short moment was something else for me i would try to explain it but
i cant
it really felt something else like another area like i am in middle of nowhere and suddenly my mind start to feel heavy,
things were pleasent but then i came back to reality, i could feel the softness of her hand
when i will sleep today i would feel her way deeper
all these is just my fantasy i try to forget all these but i couldnt
fantasy? huh.
in case i dont see yall goodnight
